text_blocks.snippet: While the WHO ended the public health emergency for COVID-19 on May 5, 2023, the disease itself continues to circulate. Whether the pandemic is truly over is debated, as definitions of "pandemic" vary, and COVID-19 continues to cause illness and death. The World Health Organization (WHO) acknowledges that clinical pathways developed during the pandemic are being sustained to support ongoing care for COVID-19 and long COVID. Vaccination efforts also remain a key part of managing the disease.

However, the virus is still circulating widely, and every new infection is associated with a risk.
